summary: Iteration 20 — Rich text long_description (TipTap), heading hierarchy audit, server-side SEO (meta/html/sitemap/robots), /auth/session, WebP uploads, lazy routes. Backend: 14/14 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20.py. Frontend: FOUND 2 CRITICAL JS BUGS crashing /kurslar and <CourseCard> (used on Home) due to undefined identifiers — fixed in place. After fix, all pages (Home, /kurslar, /canli-grup-egitimleri, course detail, group detail) have exactly ONE H1 and no skipped heading levels. Rich editor paste correctly shifts <h1>→<h2>, preserves bold and lists when pasting Google-Docs-style HTML into an empty editor. Public /kurslar/<slug> shows [data-testid=course-long-description-section] after curriculum with the saved formatted HTML. Mobile 390px — no horizontal overflow on course or group detail. Group promo poster rendered (promo_video not set so iframe correctly hidden). /auth/session returns {user:null} anon and user when authenticated; logout clears session. SEO HTML includes title/meta/canonical/og/jsonld/__INITIAL__/prerendered <h1>; 404 for unknown slug carries noindex. Sitemap lists courses+groups+instructors; robots.txt has absolute Sitemap. Image upload returns webp content-type when ?w=400 is requested.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught ReferenceError: i is not defined — map callback uses `idx` but code referenced `i`. Caused entire /kurslar page to crash with no H1 and empty root.
`optImg` used but never imported — <CourseCard> threw at render time on Home page, resulting in missing H1 and partial render.

integration_issues.flow: Rich editor paste when cursor is inside existing paragraph
integration_issues.issue:
When pasting Google-Docs-like HTML (wrapped in ...) into a NON-EMPTY paragraph, the first

(after h1→h2 shift) is inlined/stripped so the heading text is merged into the paragraph as plain text. Pasting into an empty editor works fine. Likely needs the transformPastedHTML to also unwrap Google Docs wrappers before block headings so prosemirror can keep them as block nodes regardless of cursor context.

action_items: Review the two JS fixes applied (Courses.jsx `i`→`idx`, CourseCard.jsx added `import { optImg } from '@/lib/page'`) — these were critical runtime crashes on /kurslar and Home.

Improve RichTextEditor.transformPastedHTML to also unwrap <b style='font-weight:normal' ...> wrappers (common Google Docs envelope) so pasted headings survive even when cursor is inside an existing paragraph.
critical_code_review_comments: Courses.jsx used an undefined `i` inside the map callback — this is the kind of error that would be caught by eslint `no-undef`; ensure lint is enabled on CI.
CourseCard.jsx used `optImg` without importing — same no-undef class of bug. Both bugs crashed major pages but were only visible via browser (React just rendered an error boundary / blank root).

RichTextEditor.transformPastedHTML regex only replaces h1→h2 but doesn't unwrap Google Docs <b style='font-weight:normal'> wrappers; when pasting into non-empty paragraphs, the headings get collapsed by prosemirror's inline-mark context. Consider stripping those wrappers in the transform.
routes_seo.build_seo returns a shell cached for 60s via FRONTEND_INTERNAL_URL; works fine but if frontend restarts the shell can be stale. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (core flows pass after 2 critical fixes; one paste-into-paragraph edge case fails)

Admin test image uploaded via /admin/upload-image was deleted via /admin/uploads/<id>.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview is CRA dev; server-side SEO HTML only reachable at /api/seo/html?path=... (confirmed working). Backend tests cover auth session, SEO meta/html/sitemap/robots, course+group long_description round-trip, webp image resize. Playwright confirmed heading hierarchy for 5 primary pages after the 2 JS fixes. The paste-into-existing-paragraph behavior is a known residual issue; task spec says 'h1 becomes h2' — true for empty-editor paste. Main agent should decide whether to harden the transform for Google Docs <b style="font-weight:normal"> envelope.
rca of the issue: Two unrelated frontend regressions blocked rendering: (1) /kurslar — in Courses.jsx the map callback destructures `(c, idx)` but img's `loading` prop referenced a stray `i` (likely leftover from refactor). Browser threw ReferenceError which React surfaced as a page-level error boundary. Fix: replace `i` with `idx`. (2) Home — the shared <CourseCard> component used `optImg(course.thumbnail,...)` but never imported `optImg`. Fix: add `import { optImg } from '@/lib/page'`. Both were caught by Playwright pageerror listener and the devserver error overlay.
